name: Fleet-Scale Autonomous Vehicle Telemetry Ingestion Platform
objective: Design a high-throughput, fault-tolerant telemetry ingestion and safety analytics platform for a global fleet of 1,000,000 autonomous vehicles generating sensor feeds (LiDAR, radar, CAN-bus, camera metadata) at 10Hz.
constraints: Peak ingestion capacity of 10,000,000 messages/second with p99 ingest latency under 20ms
ISO 26262 ASIL D safety compliance and immutable audit logging
Zero data loss guarantee for critical collision avoidance telemetry packets
Multi-cloud regional deployment with automatic cellular failover
End-to-end encryption using vehicle-embedded Hardware Security Modules (HSM)

components.name: Cellular Edge Telemetry Gateway
components.responsibility: Terminates mTLS cellular connections from vehicle telematics control units (TCU), verifies HSM client certificates, and unpacks Protobuf telemetry packets.

components.name: Distributed Telemetry Ingestion Buffer
components.technology: Apache Kafka (KRaft mode) on NVMe storage
components.responsibility: Partitioned event streaming buffer partitioned by geographic tile and vehicle VIN with replication factor of 3 across AZs.

components.name: Real-Time Anomaly & Collision Processing Engine
components.responsibility: Stateful sliding-window analysis for sudden deceleration, LiDAR obstacle clustering, and real-time fleet collision hazard alerting.

components.name: Operational Time-Series Telemetry Store
components.responsibility: Provides 30-day indexed time-series queries for fleet operators, active vehicle diagnostic monitoring, and dispatch optimization.

components.name: Petabyte-Scale Autonomous Perception Lakehouse
components.technology: Apache Iceberg / Parquet on AWS S3 / Cloudflare R2
components.responsibility: Immutable long-term retention of raw driving perception data for autonomous driving model retraining and regulatory compliance.

security_threats: SPOOFING: Adversary transmits forged CAN-bus collision telemetry to trigger emergency braking
TAMPERING: Man-in-the-middle manipulation of cellular base station firmware update over-the-air (OTA)
DENIAL_OF_SERVICE: Cellular cell tower saturation jamming real-time telemetry transmissions
